CustomField.description: Raw JSON body exactly as received from SFCC on /cara/createOrder. This is the sole source of truth for Retry Sync — the centralized sync service re-parses this field, so SFCC never needs to resend the request. Contains customer name/email/address; never contains card numbers, CVV, tokens or credentials (SFCC's payload itself only carries a masked card number).
CustomField.label: Order Payload
